The worst cafe in Fukuoka!
Jan 2026 • Family
Came to this cafe with my family, ordered some dishes. One of them was Tom Yam, when I asked the waitress to make it not too spicy she burbling and went to order for the kitchen! When the plate of Tom Yam was brought in it was a shock, in the first place there was actually two spoons and one shrimp, but when I tasted it it was so spicy I couldn't even swallow it, although when I was in Asian countries always asked and the chefs did the request! On my rejection of this dish, and I have every right to do so, if I don't like the dish and I haven't eaten it, some circus has started! The owner was supposedly summoned, but I doubt it was him, most likely the cook he started with red eyes proving to us that we owe him. I tried to explain that I didn't like the dish, but they started threatening the police, I was just shocked by the attitude of the staff. And that tourists have absolutely no rights in a foreign country they arrange their own rules , not international. Why then work with tourists if you have absolutely no respect for your guests. Called all the security, started saying they were the police when they weren't! Imagine we're a couple with two kids and they just threaten us and scare our kids! It wasn't about money at all, it was about attitudes towards people, it felt like they didn't see us as tourists, but wallets to be ripped off! I don't recommend this cafe to anyone, it'll be more expensive for yourself, and it's not very good to cook, the cafe was much better nearby and the staff and the dishes are delicious, but we decided to go to this horrible cafe called the deck👎
